LanguageData.CC_Settings_TerritoryNewsQuiet: Distant new settlements in the colony news (Faction Territories and Vassalage)
LanguageData.CC_Settings_TerritoryNewsQuiet_Tip: With Faction Territories and Vassalage: each people founds new settlements at the edge of its territory, and the mod tells each start and each completion as a message, a message or two a day in a world of many peoples. With this on, only those within the region map's reach of your homes stay messages; those further away go to the colony news (the evening letter, by the Colony news setting) as world news. Needs the deeper game hooks.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_TerritoryNewsQuiet: With Faction Territories and Vassalage, new settlements far away go to the evening news instead of a message each.
